structured_output.what_is_happening: About 32 minutes ago someone launched "ACT I: Effective Accelerationism" (act/acc) on pump.fun. Created and migrated timestamps are 1 second apart, which points to a bundled buy straight through the bonding curve. The coin ran to an ATH near $1.5M market cap and has since fallen about 87% to about $205k, including -56% to -58% in the last 5 minutes. Volume is extreme: about $5.7M in roughly 30 minutes against about $46-50k liquidity. There are about 3.2k unique buyers and 2.4k unique sellers, and 512 GMGN-tagged bundler wallets. This is a post-peak collapse with very heavy two-way trading.

narrative.description: The name riffs on ACT I: The AI Prophecy (ACT, a 2024 AI-agent memecoin) and the e/acc / act/acc meme. The coin has an X account and a website (actacc.pro), but there is no description. It may be tied to some news or post from the ACT/AI-agent community; that cannot be verified here.
narrative.why_spreading: Nostalgia for a known AI-meme brand plus the e/acc meme drew a fast rush of 3k+ buyers. Five same-name copycats launched within minutes, which shows the name is circulating, but price action says the first wave is already fading.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the earliest pair created, and it is the only same-name token with real liquidity and volume. The copycats are dead or near zero.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Six same-name or same-ticker tokens, all with roughly $0 liquidity (e.g. 2BdTut... at $67k mcap with no liquidity, HNBXZ... at $50k with $0 liquidity).

authenticity.evidence: Against: an instant-migration bundled launch, 512 bundler wallets, 26% top-bundler trader share and 431 fresh wallets. For: 3.2k unique buyers, a diffuse top-10 at 12.4%, a dev holding only 0.18%, a Binance-funded creator, no paid boosts, and LP burned 100%. It looks like an insider-seeded launch that pulled in a large organic crowd, then insiders dumped at the top.
authenticity.uncertainty: The X posts and the reason for the hype can't be seen. The dev's X account has launched 5 tokens, so this may be a serial launcher.

structural_risks: The price is already down about 87% from ATH and falling fast (m5 -56%)
The bundled launch leaves supply spread across many bundler wallets that can keep selling
Liquidity of about $46k is thin compared with the volume, so price swings are violent
The dev X account has launched 5 tokens (serial launcher)

structured_output.counterargument: The attention is large and real: 3k+ unique buyers, $5.7M volume, a canonical ticker and a known brand. LP is burned and holders are spread out. A dead-cat bounce from $200k back to $400k+ (still far below the $1.5M ATH) is quite plausible within 6h if the story gets fresh X attention. That makes this a better-than-average runner candidate compared with dormant microcaps.
unknowns: What triggered the hype, and whether any official ACT/AI-agent figure is involved
Whether the bundler wallets have already exited
How the next 4 minutes of price action go before entry
The dev's past 5 launches and how they ended

source_coverage.notes: No internet in this condition; judged from the packet only.

structured_output.thesis: This is a bundled launch of a recognisable AI/e-acc meme that drew a real crowd, pumped to about $1.5M and is now crashing hard. Entry would come mid-dump. A 2x rebound to about $400k needs a second wave of attention. That is possible given the breadth of buyers, but the more likely path is continued bleeding as bundlers sell out. Runner odds are somewhat above the pool's typical coin because attention is strong, but still low.
